pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Ruined Pyramid.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: The current setting enables arrow protection. Player explosions, ordinary explosions, trident damage, fall damage and mob-projectile damage are also rejected separately. Bring melee equipment; TNT and a bow do not solve this encounter.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Crystal Of Sandstorm. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Next step
pages.text: This victory belongs to the branch for: Ancient Remnant. The other victories in that branch are also required. Sibling prerequisite encounters can be completed in any order.
